tutoring-puzzle--b00--objective-0.text: Explain why a score gap between two groups does not, on its own, prove that the program caused the difference.
tutoring-puzzle--b00--objective-0.speechText: Explain why a score gap between two groups does not, on its own, prove that the program caused the difference.

tutoring-puzzle--b00--objective-1.text: Name the hidden factor that can inflate or deflate the gap we see in the data.
tutoring-puzzle--b00--objective-1.speechText: Name the hidden factor that can inflate or deflate the gap we see in the data.

tutoring-puzzle--b00--objective-2.text: Describe what it would mean to truly ___change the system___ to find out whether tutoring works.
tutoring-puzzle--b00--objective-2.speechText: Describe what it would mean to truly change the system to find out whether tutoring works.

tutoring-puzzle--b02--p.text: A school report lands on the table with a bold headline: ___students who received tutoring scored higher on the end-of-term test___. Sounds like proof that tutoring works, right?
tutoring-puzzle--b02--p.speechText: A school report lands on the table with a bold headline: students who received tutoring scored higher on the end-of-term test. Sounds like proof that tutoring works, right?

tutoring-puzzle--b03--p.text: Not so fast. Before we celebrate, we need to ask one question: ___were the two groups already different before tutoring ever started?___ That single question is the heart of causal thinking.
tutoring-puzzle--b03--p.speechText: Not so fast. Before we celebrate, we need to ask one question: were the two groups already different before tutoring ever started? That single question is the heart of causal thinking.

tutoring-puzzle--b04--caption.text: A school noticeboard shows a score gap between tutored and not-tutored students. The question is what is behind that gap.
tutoring-puzzle--b04--caption.speechText: A school noticeboard shows a score gap between tutored and not-tutored students. The question is what is behind that gap.

tutoring-puzzle--b06--p.text: Most of us have heard a headline like this and nodded along: ___the tutored group scored higher, so tutoring must have helped___. It feels logical. If A comes before B, and B looks better, A must be the reason.
tutoring-puzzle--b06--p.speechText: Most of us have heard a headline like this and nodded along: the tutored group scored higher, so tutoring must have helped. It feels logical. If A comes before B, and B looks better, A must be the reason.

tutoring-puzzle--b07--p.text: But here is the catch: the students who received tutoring may have already been different from those who did not — before a single tutoring session happened. In some schools, extra support is directed toward students who are struggling. In others, tutoring is optional or private, and motivated or already high-attaining students may be more likely to sign up. Either way, the two groups are not identical twins waiting to be compared.
tutoring-puzzle--b07--p.speechText: But here is the catch: the students who received tutoring may have already been different from those who did not — before a single tutoring session happened. In some schools, extra support is directed toward students who are struggling. In others, tutoring is optional or private, and motivated or already high-attaining students may be more likely to sign up. Either way, the two groups are not identical twins waiting to be compared.

tutoring-puzzle--b08--callout.text: When the groups start out different, the gap we see in the final scores is a ___mixture___ — part tutoring effect, part pre-existing difference. Treating the whole gap as proof of tutoring is the misconception we are here to untangle.
tutoring-puzzle--b08--callout.speechText: When the groups start out different, the gap we see in the final scores is a mixture — part tutoring effect, part pre-existing difference. Treating the whole gap as proof of tutoring is the misconception we are here to untangle.

tutoring-puzzle--b09--caption.text: The score gap may include both a tutoring effect and a pre-existing difference between the groups.
tutoring-puzzle--b09--caption.speechText: The score gap may include both a tutoring effect and a pre-existing difference between the groups.

tutoring-puzzle--b12--card-0.text: Prior Achievement. What a student already knew before tutoring began.
tutoring-puzzle--b12--card-0.speechText: Prior Achievement. What a student already knew before tutoring began.

tutoring-puzzle--b12--card-1.text: Tutoring Assignment. Whether that student ended up receiving tutoring.
tutoring-puzzle--b12--card-1.speechText: Tutoring Assignment. Whether that student ended up receiving tutoring.

tutoring-puzzle--b12--card-2.text: Test Score. The later score we want to understand.
tutoring-puzzle--b12--card-2.speechText: Test Score. The later score we want to understand.

tutoring-puzzle--b13--p.text: Here is the key move: ___Prior Achievement does not just affect the final test score directly___ — it also influences who gets tutoring in the first place. That gives us two roads from PriorAchievement to TestScore.
tutoring-puzzle--b13--p.speechText: Here is the key move: Prior Achievement does not just affect the final test score directly — it also influences who gets tutoring in the first place. That gives us two roads from Prior Achievement to Test Score.

tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-0.text: The direct road. A student who already knew a lot walks into the test with an advantage, tutoring or not.
tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-0.speechText: The direct road. A student who already knew a lot walks into the test with an advantage, tutoring or not.

tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-0-note.text: This is the pre-existing difference we need to account for.
tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-0-note.speechText: This is the pre-existing difference we need to account for.

tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-1.text: The tutoring road. Prior achievement shapes whether a student is assigned tutoring, and tutoring then shapes the score.
tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-1.speechText: The tutoring road. Prior achievement shapes whether a student is assigned tutoring, and tutoring then shapes the score.

tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-1-note.text: This is the effect we want to isolate.
tutoring-puzzle--b14--road-1-note.speechText: This is the effect we want to isolate.

tutoring-puzzle--b15--p.text: When we simply compare the tutored group to the non-tutored group, we are measuring the combined effect of ___both roads at once___. The raw gap in the bar chart blends them together.
tutoring-puzzle--b15--p.speechText: When we simply compare the tutored group to the non-tutored group, we are measuring the combined effect of both roads at once. The raw gap in the bar chart blends them together.

tutoring-puzzle--b16--p.text: To isolate what tutoring itself does, we need to balance prior achievement across the two groups on average — or, better still, change the assignment rule ourselves so that prior achievement no longer decides who gets tutoring.
tutoring-puzzle--b16--p.speechText: To isolate what tutoring itself does, we need to balance prior achievement across the two groups on average — or, better still, change the assignment rule ourselves so that prior achievement no longer decides who gets tutoring.

tutoring-puzzle--b18--p.text: The diagram below maps the three characters and their connections. PriorAchievement sits at the top of both paths. It is the hidden driver that touches both sides of the comparison.
tutoring-puzzle--b18--p.speechText: The diagram below maps the three characters and their connections. Prior Achievement sits at the top of both paths. It is the hidden driver that touches both sides of the comparison.

tutoring-puzzle--b20--p.text: The bar chart the school published lives in the ___observational world___. Both roads are open. The gap between the bars is real, but it carries the fingerprints of prior achievement as well as tutoring.
tutoring-puzzle--b20--p.speechText: The bar chart the school published lives in the observational world. Both roads are open. The gap between the bars is real, but it carries the fingerprints of prior achievement as well as tutoring.

tutoring-puzzle--b21--callout.text: That second idea is simple: change the rule ourselves. If students are assigned tutoring by a coin flip, prior achievement no longer decides who gets tutoring, so the hidden road into assignment is broken.
tutoring-puzzle--b21--callout.speechText: That second idea is simple: change the rule ourselves. If students are assigned tutoring by a coin flip, prior achievement no longer decides who gets tutoring, so the hidden road into assignment is broken.

tutoring-puzzle--b22--caption.text: Left: observational world, where groups may already differ. Right: intervention world, where assignment is independent of prior achievement.
tutoring-puzzle--b22--caption.speechText: Left: observational world, where groups may already differ. Right: intervention world, where assignment is independent of prior achievement.

changing-the-rule--b00--objective-0.text: Explain what it means to ___change the assignment rule___ for who gets tutoring.
changing-the-rule--b00--objective-0.speechText: Explain what it means to change the assignment rule for who gets tutoring.

changing-the-rule--b00--objective-1.text: Describe why flipping a coin to assign tutoring gives a cleaner picture than just watching who happened to get it.
changing-the-rule--b00--objective-1.speechText: Describe why flipping a coin to assign tutoring gives a cleaner picture than just watching who happened to get it.

changing-the-rule--b00--objective-2.text: Identify which link in the diagram disappears when we intervene on tutoring assignment.
changing-the-rule--b00--objective-2.speechText: Identify which link in the diagram disappears when we intervene on tutoring assignment.

changing-the-rule--b02--p.text: Imagine a school report lands on your desk. Students who got tutoring scored higher. Great news — but wait. Were those students already different before tutoring started? If so, the score gap might be telling us partly about ___prior knowledge___, not tutoring alone.
changing-the-rule--b02--p.speechText: Imagine a school report lands on your desk. Students who got tutoring scored higher. Great news — but wait. Were those students already different before tutoring started? If so, the score gap might be telling us partly about prior knowledge, not tutoring alone.

changing-the-rule--b03--p.text: In the last lesson we saw how PriorAchievement quietly shapes both who gets tutoring and how students score. This lesson is about a simple but powerful move: ___what if we take that decision out of the school's hands entirely and flip a coin instead?___
changing-the-rule--b03--p.speechText: In the last lesson we saw how Prior Achievement quietly shapes both who gets tutoring and how students score. This lesson is about a simple but powerful move: what if we take that decision out of the school's hands entirely and flip a coin instead?

changing-the-rule--b04--caption.text: Left: who happened to get tutoring. Right: who we decided to assign by coin flip.
changing-the-rule--b04--caption.speechText: Left: who happened to get tutoring. Right: who we decided to assign by coin flip.

changing-the-rule--b06--callout.text: ___'If I just look at students who received tutoring, isn't that the same as studying what tutoring does?'___
changing-the-rule--b06--callout.speechText: 'If I just look at students who received tutoring, isn't that the same as studying what tutoring does?'

changing-the-rule--b07--p.text: It feels that way — but it is not. When you filter to students who received tutoring, you are looking at a group that may already differ from everyone else. Some schools direct extra support toward students who are struggling; other settings see motivated or already high-attaining students opt in. Either way, the group you end up studying is shaped by something other than tutoring itself.
changing-the-rule--b07--p.speechText: It feels that way — but it is not. When you filter to students who received tutoring, you are looking at a group that may already differ from everyone else. Some schools direct extra support toward students who are struggling; other settings see motivated or already high-attaining students opt in. Either way, the group you end up studying is shaped by something other than tutoring itself.

changing-the-rule--b08--callout.text: Assigning tutoring ___by design___ — say, by coin flip — is different. You are creating the groups yourself, on your own terms, so that prior achievement no longer determines who ends up where.
changing-the-rule--b08--callout.speechText: Assigning tutoring by design — say, by coin flip — is different. You are creating the groups yourself, on your own terms, so that prior achievement no longer determines who ends up where.

changing-the-rule--b10--p.text: Picture the original situation. The school uses student records to decide who gets tutoring. That means PriorAchievement is quietly steering TutoringAssignment. Students with certain backgrounds are more or less likely to be assigned — and that background ___also___ affects TestScore.
changing-the-rule--b10--p.speechText: Picture the original situation. The school uses student records to decide who gets tutoring. That means Prior Achievement is quietly steering Tutoring Assignment. Students with certain backgrounds are more or less likely to be assigned — and that background also affects Test Score.

changing-the-rule--b11--p.text: Now picture a researcher stepping in and saying: ___'We are going to flip a coin for every student. Heads gets tutoring, tails does not.'___ The school's old rule — the one that connected prior achievement to tutoring assignment — is gone. It has been replaced.
changing-the-rule--b11--p.speechText: Now picture a researcher stepping in and saying: 'We are going to flip a coin for every student. Heads gets tutoring, tails does not.' The school's old rule — the one that connected prior achievement to tutoring assignment — is gone. It has been replaced.

changing-the-rule--b12--p.text: This replacement is what researchers call an ___intervention___: not just observing who got tutoring, but actively deciding who gets it regardless of background.
changing-the-rule--b12--p.speechText: This replacement is what researchers call an intervention: not just observing who got tutoring, but actively deciding who gets it regardless of background.

changing-the-rule--b14--p.text: After that change, the coin is the only thing determining T. Prior achievement still affects test scores directly — that link stays — but it no longer has any say in who gets tutoring. The score gap we measure now is a much cleaner picture of what tutoring itself does.
changing-the-rule--b14--p.speechText: After that change, the coin is the only thing determining T. Prior achievement still affects test scores directly — that link stays — but it no longer has any say in who gets tutoring. The score gap we measure now is a much cleaner picture of what tutoring itself does.

changing-the-rule--b15--callout.text: PriorAchievement still influences TestScore. TutoringAssignment still influences TestScore. What disappears is the link from PriorAchievement to TutoringAssignment.
changing-the-rule--b15--callout.speechText: Prior Achievement still influences Test Score. Tutoring Assignment still influences Test Score. What disappears is the link from Prior Achievement to Tutoring Assignment.

changing-the-rule--b18--caption.text: Before: the school decides. After: the coin flip decides. Only the road into tutoring assignment is cut.
changing-the-rule--b18--caption.speechText: Before: the school decides. After: the coin flip decides. Only the road into tutoring assignment is cut.
